import re

print(df.dtypes)

# Extract carrier label from evidence text
def extract_carrier(evidence):
    if not isinstance(evidence, str):
        return None
    m = re.search(r'([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]+(?:Ship|Carrier|Logistics|Line|Express|Fast|Budget)?)[^\.]*\b(has|had|was|is)\b', evidence)
    if m:
        return m.group(1)
    evidence2 = re.sub(r'^(Evidence|Archive|Note):\s*', '', evidence)
    return evidence2.split()[0] if evidence2 else None

work = df.copy()
work["carrier"] = work["evidence"].apply(extract_carrier)
work["is_complaint_record"] = work["evidence"].astype(str).str.contains("complaint", case=False, na=False)

valid = work[work["carrier"].notna()].copy()

result = (
    valid.groupby("carrier", as_index=False)
    .agg(
        total_records=("doc_id", "size"),
        complaint_records=("is_complaint_record", "sum")
    )
)

result["complaint_rate"] = result["complaint_records"] / result["total_records"]
result = result.sort_values(["complaint_rate", "carrier"], ascending=[True, True]).reset_index(drop=True)

print(result.to_string(index=False))
```
